> [!WARNING]
> This template creates a public GitHub issue. Do not include private contact details, sensitive personal information, or anything that should not be public. For a sensitive concern, contact the maintainer through [X (@kate_alt_69)](https://x.com/kate_alt_69).

## Incident summary

**Who was involved?**
Names or usernames are optional.

**When and where did this happen?**
Include links to relevant issues, pull requests, comments, or public discussions where possible.

## Description

Describe what happened and why you believe it may violate the Code of Conduct. Please stick to details you are comfortable sharing publicly.

## Public evidence or context

Add links to public comments, issues, pull requests, or other relevant material. Do not upload private messages or personal information without permission.

## Follow-up

- [ ] I am comfortable being contacted in this public issue.
- [ ] I prefer no public follow-up.
